title: Baseline & Implement Frame30 SDLC Control Plane (F30-SDLC-001 Stage 0 & 1)
objective: Execute Stage 0 (Baseline & Contradictions Audit) and Stage 1 (SDLC Policy & Control Plane) to establish Requirement-First, Proof-Backed Development and the Permanent-Die registry without modifying production application behavior
merchant_or_user_outcome: Frame30 capabilities are protected by immutable versioned dies and mechanical verification gates, preventing regression of accepted behaviors and eliminating circular self-verification by autonomous agents
problem_and_evidence: Autonomous agents risk circular verification by inspecting current implementation bugs and declaring them requirements. A unified, 18-state lifecycle and permanent-die registry is required to bind implementation to human-owned laws.
behavioral_requirements: Requirement-First direction strictly enforced: agent cannot unilaterally redefine acceptance criteria
Scope Guard validates Git diff against active change contract and exits non-zero on unauthorized paths
Verification Drift gate locks production hashes to formal models and fails closed on desynchronization
Mutation sensitivity suite proves detection across deliberate control plane and domain defects
CircleCI remains the sole CI authority with blocking status gates
forbidden_behaviors: Modifying any production storefront, checkout, commerce, or payment execution path in this ticket
Weakening any existing test or property check to achieve a passing status
Self-approving merge or deployment without human authorization

security.tenant_boundary: No tenant or auth schema changes permitted in this ticket
roles_scopes: Human Owner (@devrahmanbd) holds sole approval authority
security.threat_model: Autonomous agent containment against unauthorized scope expansion, test weakening, and circular self-verification

migration.rollback_or_forward_fix: Git revert commit cleanly restores previous baseline

rollback_trigger: Any invariant violation or unauthorized file modification

required_invariants: Scope guard rejects unauthorized file changes outside allowed_file_changes
Verification drift gate detects source hash changes
Lean 4 lake build succeeds with zero sorry
Bend 2 verification passes with Lean-backed kernel
TLA+ TLC model checker passes without errors
Fast-check property tests pass without counterexamples
required_acceptance: Stage 0 audit report F30-AUDIT-STAGE0-001 published and verified
SDLC specification F30-SDLC-001 updated in docs/governance/sdlc-specification.md
Permanent-Die system structure established in dies/
